headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving gains but profit margins under pressure.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest double‑digit to very high double‑digit, led by Coforge and Persistent. Profit expansion was uneven; HCLTech posted a 21% jump while Wipro saw a 1.9% decline. Guidance was trimmed for Infosys and introduced for HCLTech and Wipro. AI revenue contributions were highlighted across several firms, underscoring its growing importance.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue expansion
themes.detail: Multiple companies cited AI as a key growth driver, with AI revenue rising 29% at Infosys and $466 m at Mphasis.

themes.title: Margin and profit divergence
themes.detail: Operating margins stayed strong at TCS (24%) and OFSS (47.8%) but profit growth lagged at Wipro and Infosys.

themes.title: Dividend and guidance adjustments
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue guidance, while Coforge raised its EBIT margin outlook and several firms announced higher interim dividends.
